buildings.name: Chieftain hut
buildings.description: The seat of your chief. Every nation starts with one at its capital, and its people gather food and wood without needing workers.

buildings.name: Great hall
buildings.description: The chief's Medieval hall, upgraded from the hut. It gathers more food and wood, still without workers.

buildings.name: Town hall
buildings.description: The seat of a Gunpowder-era town. It has no effect yet and, unlike the great hall, gathers nothing, so upgrading to it loses that food and wood.

buildings.name: Parliament
buildings.description: The seat of an Industrial government. It has no effect yet and gathers nothing.

buildings.name: Wooden watchtower
buildings.description: A wooden lookout on your land. It has no effect on combat yet.

buildings.name: Stone tower
buildings.description: A Medieval stone tower, upgraded from the watchtower. It has no effect on combat yet.

buildings.name: Concrete tower
buildings.description: A Modern concrete tower. It has no effect on combat yet.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description: Trains every soldier type your research has unlocked, twice as fast as a war camp. Set how many to keep in the Army panel.

buildings.name: Storage yard
buildings.description: An open yard for stockpiles, for when goods have to be carried from place to place. It has no effect yet.

buildings.name: Warehouse
buildings.description: An Industrial store for goods, upgraded from the storage yard. It has no effect yet.

buildings.name: Logistics depot
buildings.description: A Modern hub for moving goods between stores. It has no effect yet.

buildings.name: Jetty
buildings.description: A wooden landing on the shore. Troops your ships land within two plots of it lose nobody. Sea trade comes later.

buildings.name: Harbour
buildings.description: A Medieval harbour, upgraded from the jetty. It builds galleys and cogs, and troops landed near it lose nobody.

buildings.name: Commercial port
buildings.description: A large Industrial port for trade by sea. It has no effect yet.

buildings.name: Offshore rig
buildings.description: A platform on shallow water, meant for oil and gas at sea. It has no effect yet.

buildings.name: Grass hut
buildings.description: A home your people build by themselves on residential zones. Residents pay tax, eat food, take jobs and raise your troop limit.

buildings.name: Timber cottage
buildings.description: A Medieval timber home. Your people upgrade huts to cottages once they are well fed and have work.

buildings.name: Brick house
buildings.description: A Gunpowder-era brick home with room for more people.

buildings.name: Tenement
buildings.description: An Industrial block of flats that fits many families on one plot.

buildings.name: Apartment block
buildings.description: A Modern apartment block that houses hundreds of people.

buildings.name: Eco tower
buildings.description: A Future-era green tower, the biggest home there is.

buildings.name: Market stall
buildings.description: A stall your people set up on commercial zones. It gives them work, and people without work are less content.

buildings.name: Bakery
buildings.description: A Medieval bakery, upgraded from a stall, with more jobs.

buildings.name: General store
buildings.description: A Gunpowder-era store with more jobs.

buildings.name: Shop
buildings.description: An Industrial shop with more jobs.

buildings.name: Cafe
buildings.description: A Modern cafe, the commercial building with the most jobs.

buildings.name: Forge
buildings.description: A Medieval workshop your people set up on industrial zones. It gives work and makes goods, which people need from the Medieval era on.

buildings.name: Foundry
buildings.description: A Gunpowder-era works, upgraded from the forge, that makes more goods and gives more work.

buildings.name: Early factory
buildings.description: An Industrial factory that makes goods in bulk.

buildings.name: Modern factory
buildings.description: A Modern factory, the biggest maker of goods.

buildings.name: Woodcutter camp
buildings.description: Cuts wood from the forest around it. Forest cut bare turns into cleared land, which slowly grows back next to healthy forest.

buildings.name: Quarry
buildings.description: Digs stone. It must sit on a stone deposit and stops when the deposit runs dry.

buildings.name: Clay pit
buildings.description: Digs clay, which brick homes and later buildings need. It must sit on a clay deposit.

buildings.name: Fishing hut
buildings.description: Catches fish for food. It needs fishing water close by.

buildings.name: Wheat field
buildings.description: A wheat field that grows food. Fertile soil yields more; summer gives the most and winter the least.

buildings.name: Sheep pasture
buildings.description: Sheep grazing on grassland, for food. It yields less in winter.

buildings.name: Cattle pasture
buildings.description: Cattle grazing on grassland. A little more food than sheep, and less in winter.

buildings.name: Pit mine
buildings.description: A Medieval mine for iron, copper, tin, coal, gold, silver and gems. It must sit on a deposit and digs whatever the deposit holds.

buildings.name: Sawmill
buildings.description: A Medieval mill, upgraded from the woodcutter camp. It cuts wood far faster, from a wider ring of forest.

buildings.name: Fishing dock
buildings.description: A Medieval dock, upgraded from the fishing hut, that catches more fish.

buildings.name: Mine shaft
buildings.description: An Industrial deep mine. It digs faster than a pit mine and also reaches uranium, bauxite and sulfur.

buildings.name: Open-pit mine
buildings.description: A Modern open-pit mine, the fastest there is, for iron, copper, coal, bauxite and lithium under or right beside it.

buildings.name: Oil derrick
buildings.description: Pumps oil. It must sit on an oil deposit.

buildings.name: Pumpjack
buildings.description: A Modern pump, upgraded from the derrick, that draws oil faster.

buildings.name: War camp
buildings.description: Where levies train as club warriors, spear throwers and horse archers. Set how many to keep in the Army panel.

buildings.name: Siege workshop
buildings.description: Builds catapults and trebuchets, one after another from its queue.

buildings.name: Gas plant
buildings.description: Draws natural gas. It must sit on a gas deposit.
